timeline.summary: Ashapura Minechem announced postal ballot results approving ESOP 2026, CEO re-appointment, and independent director regularizations.
Ashapura Minechem published the scrutinizer's report for the postal ballot approving ESOP 2026 and board appointments.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,968.63 Cr (+254.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹110.73 Cr (+28.0% YoY).
Ashapura Minechem reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,968.6 Cr and PBT of ₹146.8 Cr, driven by strong growth in Guinea bauxite export volumes.
Ashapura Minechem Ltd. hosted an earnings conference call on June 4, 2026, from 4:00 PM to 5:04 PM IST, discussing Q4 & FY2026 performance with investors and analysts.
Ashapura Minechem hosted its Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call on June 4, 2026, guiding for 10-12 million tons of bauxite exports in FY27.

Ashapura Minechem held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 19, 2026, reporting revenue growth of 19.2% YoY to ₹1,616 Cr with stable EBITDA at ₹188.9 Cr, while facing margin pressure from elevated freight costs.
